pages.text: Atum has four mineshaft variants. Look for Deadwood supports and timber passages in the $(thing)Deadwood Mineshaft$(), or limestone supports in the $(thing)Limestone Mineshaft$(). Both have underground variants.

In Limestone Mountains, the $(thing)Surface Deadwood Mineshaft$() and $(thing)Surface Limestone Mineshaft$() begin nearer the surface. Search for exposed openings and descended corridors. Mine the surrounding limestone while you explore.
Expect branching corridors, crossings, rooms, and stairs. Mark junctions and carry backup light. Rails can guide you between workings. Leave space to retreat from narrow passages.
